questions.prompt: CPU is low, yet new calls fail near a repeatable load. What else can limit capacity?
options: Sockets, ports, networking or other resources
Nothing; low CPU proves spare capacity
questions.explanation: CPU is one resource. Inspect actual failure evidence and configured transport rather than assuming a universal port-per-call ratio.

questions.prompt: Why can CPU-only autoscaling miss a setup bottleneck?
options: Arrival pressure can exhaust admission before CPU is high
Every setup failure is a CPU failure
questions.explanation: Use signals that reflect the stressed layer, including queueing, dispatch delay and errors.

questions.prompt: How should a capacity estimate be validated?
options: Multiply a single successful call by fleet size
Use monthly minutes as peak concurrency
Load-test the proposed fleet and failure scenarios
questions.explanation: Capacity is constrained by multiple resources and traffic shape. Monthly volume does not establish peak load.
